scenarios.title: Save changes to every editable task detail
evidence: Playwright MCP edited title, notes, category, priority, and due date on seed-1; exactly one updated task was shown, its incomplete state and id were preserved, and localStorage contained every saved value.

scenarios.title: Reject an empty edited title
evidence: Playwright MCP submitted a whitespace title; the editor stayed open, an alert announced the error, Title had aria-invalid=true, and localStorage retained the original title.

scenarios.title: Cancel discards unsaved changes
evidence: Playwright MCP cancelled changed title and notes; original values and normal complete/edit/delete controls returned, and draft text was absent from localStorage.

scenarios.title: Saved edits persist and update filtering
evidence: Playwright MCP changed seed-1 to Health with a future date; it left Today, survived reload in Upcoming, appeared under Health with active count 2, and matched its edited title in search.

scenarios.title: Editing is accessible without breaking existing actions
evidence: Playwright MCP opened edit by keyboard, verified the task-specific form and five labeled fields, autofocus and logical Tab order, cancelled by keyboard, then added, completed, searched, and deleted a task.
